citation.authors: Saner NJ, Lee MJ-C, Kuang J, Pitchford NW, Roach GD, Garnham A, Genders AJ, Stokes T, Schroder EA, Huo Z, Esser KA, Phillips SM, Bishop DJ, Bartlett JD
citation.title: Exercise mitigates sleep-loss-induced changes in glucose tolerance, mitochondrial function, sarcoplasmic protein synthesis, and diurnal rhythms

reported.what: OGTT glucose area under the curve, sleep restriction (SR) group, pre and post intervention, mean +/- SD, n = 8; printed only in arbitrary units (A.U.)
OGTT insulin area under the curve, Normal Sleep (NS) group, pre and post intervention, mean +/- SD, n = 8; printed only in A.U.

location.where: Results, OGTT paragraph, insulin AUC (NS group)

reported.what: sarcoplasmic protein synthesis (fractional synthetic rate, %/day), SR group, mean +/- SD, n = 8, over the intervention
maximal coupled mitochondrial respiration (ETF+CI+CII)P in muscle fibres, SR group, pre and post intervention, mean +/- SD, n = 8, in pmol O2 s-1 mg-1
change in wrist skin temperature diurnal amplitude, SR group, mean +/- SD, n = 8, in °C (a peripheral skin measure, not core temperature)

detail: The paper's glucose and insulin area under the curve, its one glucose-tolerance outcome, is printed only in arbitrary units (A.U.) that cannot be converted to a concentration times minutes, and its glucose and insulin concentrations appear only in figures, so no OGTT number can be entered; the sarcoplasmic protein synthesis, mitochondrial respiration and wrist skin temperature outcomes would also need markers the model does not carry, and the multi-day sleep and diet arms would need meal times the paper does not print (its diet is given as grams per kg per day with six meal times 'kept constant').
